fusions.name: Murkwater Ambush
fusions.desc: Looses a bolt of water that deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit. For 4 seconds after, your movement speed rises 15%.

fusions.name: Scatter the Pond
fusions.desc: Swipes around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone Downstream
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with 10% more dodge chance. Using it raises your movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: One That Got Away
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a killing blow is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
